options.content: Live or pinned strategy-to-execution ladder, split local left and global right. Latest mode follows the newest ControllerDiagnostics event; pinned mode uses the selected target frame. Each chart plots marginal qty in uniform spread buckets (`spread from mid`, width = Spread max / Spread buckets) so every stage shares the same horizontal range. Bid is green, ask is red.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT e.exchange,
         e.payload
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
    AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND (
      '${target_frame_mode}' = 'latest'
      OR e.event_id = ${target_frame_event_id:sqlstring}
    )
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  ORDER BY e.ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
role_exchanges AS (
  SELECT 'local'::text AS role,
         l.exchange AS exchange
  FROM latest l
  WHERE l.exchange IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT gates.value->>'role' AS role,
         gates.key AS exchange
  FROM latest l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    CASE
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates', 'venue_gates']) = 'object' THEN l.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates', 'venue_gates']
  ELSE '{}'::jsonb
END
  ) AS gates(key, value)
  WHERE gates.value->>'role' IN ('local', 'global')
),
selected AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
           CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['state', 'mid'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['state', 'mid'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END,
           (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['cleared_orderbook', 'bids', '0', 'price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['cleared_orderbook', 'bids', '0', 'price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END + CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['cleared_orderbook', 'asks', '0', 'price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['cleared_orderbook', 'asks', '0', 'price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 2.0,
           0.0
         ) AS mid,
         GREATEST(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_max}', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_max}', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 100.0
END, 1.0) AS spread_max,
         GREATEST(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_buckets}', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_buckets}', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 40
END, 1)::int AS bucket_count
  FROM latest l
),
bucket_width AS (
  SELECT spread_max / bucket_count::double precision AS width
  FROM selected
),
orders AS (
  SELECT CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END AS series,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS value
  FROM latest l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders']) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders']) > 0 THEN l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders']
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders_sample']) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders_sample']) > 0 THEN l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders_sample']
  ELSE '[]'::jsonb
END
  ) AS o(value)
  WHERE CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END IN ('bid', 'ask')
    AND CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', '') IN (
      SELECT exchange FROM role_exchanges WHERE role = 'local'
    )
    AND CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IN (
      SELECT grid.price
      FROM (
        SELECT CASE
          WHEN trim(COALESCE(elem->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
          THEN trim(COALESCE(elem->>'price', ''))::double precision
          ELSE NULL
        END AS price
        FROM latest l
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
          COALESCE(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'continuous', 'bid'], '[]'::jsonb)
          || COALESCE(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'continuous', 'ask'], '[]'::jsonb)
        ) AS elem
      ) AS grid
      WHERE grid.price IS NOT NULL
    )
),
order_buckets AS (
  SELECT o.series,
         CASE
           WHEN (o.price - s.mid) <= 0 THEN -LEAST(
             CEIL(ABS(o.price - s.mid) / NULLIF(w.width, 0.0)) * w.width,
             s.spread_max
           )
           ELSE LEAST(
             CEIL((o.price - s.mid) / NULLIF(w.width, 0.0)) * w.width,
             s.spread_max
           )
         END AS spread,
         SUM(o.value) AS value
  FROM orders o
  CROSS JOIN selected s
  CROSS JOIN bucket_width w
  WHERE o.value > 0
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
series_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT series FROM orders WHERE value > 0
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bid' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE value > 0 AND series = 'bid')
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ask' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE value > 0 AND series = 'ask')
),
bucket_grid AS (
  SELECT gs AS bucket_idx,
         s.spread_max,
         w.width
  FROM selected s
  CROSS JOIN bucket_width w
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, s.bucket_count) AS gs
),
all_buckets AS (
  SELECT 'bid'::text AS side_key, (-g.bucket_idx * g.width) AS spread
  FROM bucket_grid g
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ask'::text AS side_key, (g.bucket_idx * g.width) AS spread
  FROM bucket_grid g
),
filled AS (
  SELECT sn.series,
         ab.spread,
         COALESCE(ob.value, 0.0) AS value
  FROM series_names sn
  CROSS JOIN all_buckets ab
  LEFT JOIN order_buckets ob
    ON ob.series = sn.series
   AND ob.spread = ab.spread
  WHERE (sn.series = 'bid' AND ab.side_key = 'bid')
     OR (sn.series = 'ask' AND ab.side_key = 'ask')
     OR (sn.series LIKE '% bid' AND ab.side_key = 'bid')
     OR (sn.series LIKE '% ask' AND ab.side_key = 'ask')
)
SELECT series, spread, value
FROM filled
ORDER BY spread, series

         e.payload
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
    AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND (
      '${target_frame_mode}' = 'latest'
      OR e.event_id = ${target_frame_event_id:sqlstring}
    )
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  ORDER BY e.ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
role_exchanges AS (
  SELECT 'local'::text AS role,
         l.exchange AS exchange
  FROM latest l
  WHERE l.exchange IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT gates.value->>'role' AS role,
         gates.key AS exchange
  FROM latest l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    CASE
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates', 'venue_gates']) = 'object' THEN l.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates', 'venue_gates']
  ELSE '{}'::jsonb
END
  ) AS gates(key, value)
  WHERE gates.value->>'role' IN ('local', 'global')
),
selected AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
           CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['state', 'global_mid'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['state', 'global_mid'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END,
           (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['global_cleared_orderbook', 'bids', '0', 'price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['global_cleared_orderbook', 'bids', '0', 'price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END + CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['global_cleared_orderbook', 'asks', '0', 'price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['global_cleared_orderbook', 'asks', '0', 'price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 2.0,
           0.0
         ) AS mid,
         GREATEST(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_max}', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_max}', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 100.0
END, 1.0) AS spread_max,
         GREATEST(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_buckets}', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_buckets}', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 40
END, 1)::int AS bucket_count
  FROM latest l
),
bucket_width AS (
  SELECT spread_max / bucket_count::double precision AS width
  FROM selected
),
orders AS (
  SELECT CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END AS series,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS value
  FROM latest l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'kept', 'orders']) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'kept', 'orders']) > 0 THEN l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'kept', 'orders']
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'kept', 'orders_sample']) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'kept', 'orders_sample']) > 0 THEN l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'kept', 'orders_sample']
  ELSE '[]'::jsonb
END
  ) AS o(value)
  WHERE CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END IN ('bid', 'ask')
    AND CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', '') IN (
      SELECT exchange FROM role_exchanges WHERE role = 'global'
    )
),
order_buckets AS (
  SELECT o.series,
         CASE
           WHEN (o.price - s.mid) <= 0 THEN -LEAST(
             CEIL(ABS(o.price - s.mid) / NULLIF(w.width, 0.0)) * w.width,
             s.spread_max
           )
           ELSE LEAST(
             CEIL((o.price - s.mid) / NULLIF(w.width, 0.0)) * w.width,
             s.spread_max
           )
         END AS spread,
         SUM(o.value) AS value
  FROM orders o
  CROSS JOIN selected s
  CROSS JOIN bucket_width w
  WHERE o.value > 0
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
series_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT series FROM orders WHERE value > 0
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bid' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE value > 0 AND series = 'bid')
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ask' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE value > 0 AND series = 'ask')
),
bucket_grid AS (
  SELECT gs AS bucket_idx,
         s.spread_max,
         w.width
  FROM selected s
  CROSS JOIN bucket_width w
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, s.bucket_count) AS gs
),
all_buckets AS (
  SELECT 'bid'::text AS side_key, (-g.bucket_idx * g.width) AS spread
  FROM bucket_grid g
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ask'::text AS side_key, (g.bucket_idx * g.width) AS spread
  FROM bucket_grid g
),
filled AS (
  SELECT sn.series,
         ab.spread,
         COALESCE(ob.value, 0.0) AS value
  FROM series_names sn
  CROSS JOIN all_buckets ab
  LEFT JOIN order_buckets ob
    ON ob.series = sn.series
   AND ob.spread = ab.spread
  WHERE (sn.series = 'bid' AND ab.side_key = 'bid')
     OR (sn.series = 'ask' AND ab.side_key = 'ask')
     OR (sn.series LIKE '% bid' AND ab.side_key = 'bid')
     OR (sn.series LIKE '% ask' AND ab.side_key = 'ask')
)
SELECT series, spread, value
FROM filled
ORDER BY spread, series

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT e.exchange,
         e.payload
  FROM mm_events e

    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  ORDER BY e.ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
role_exchanges AS (
  SELECT 'local'::text AS role,
         l.exchange AS exchange
  FROM latest l
  WHERE l.exchange IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT gates.value->>'role' AS role,
         gates.key AS exchange
  FROM latest l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    CASE
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates', 'venue_gates']) = 'object' THEN l.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates', 'venue_gates']
  ELSE '{}'::jsonb
END
  ) AS gates(key, value)
  WHERE gates.value->>'role' IN ('local', 'global')
),
selected AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
           CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['state', 'global_mid'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['state', 'global_mid'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END,
           (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['global_cleared_orderbook', 'bids', '0', 'price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['global_cleared_orderbook', 'bids', '0', 'price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END + CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['global_cleared_orderbook', 'asks', '0', 'price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['global_cleared_orderbook', 'asks', '0', 'price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 2.0,
           0.0
         ) AS mid,
         GREATEST(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_max}', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_max}', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 100.0
END, 1.0) AS spread_max,
         GREATEST(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_buckets}', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_buckets}', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 40
END, 1)::int AS bucket_count
  FROM latest l
),
bucket_width AS (
  SELECT spread_max / bucket_count::double precision AS width
  FROM selected
),
orders AS (
  SELECT CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END AS series,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS value
  FROM latest l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'rules_valid', 'rejections']) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'rules_valid', 'rejections']) > 0 THEN l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'rules_valid', 'rejections']
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'rules_valid', 'orders_sample']) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'rules_valid', 'orders_sample']) > 0 THEN l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'rules_valid', 'orders_sample']
  ELSE '[]'::jsonb
END
  ) AS o(value)
  WHERE CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END IN ('bid', 'ask')
    AND CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'reason', '') = 'rules_min_notional'
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', '') IN (
      SELECT exchange FROM role_exchanges WHERE role = 'global'
    )
),
order_buckets AS (
  SELECT o.series,
         CASE
           WHEN (o.price - s.mid) <= 0 THEN -LEAST(
             CEIL(ABS(o.price - s.mid) / NULLIF(w.width, 0.0)) * w.width,
             s.spread_max
           )
           ELSE LEAST(
             CEIL((o.price - s.mid) / NULLIF(w.width, 0.0)) * w.width,
             s.spread_max
           )
         END AS spread,
         SUM(o.value) AS value
  FROM orders o
  CROSS JOIN selected s
  CROSS JOIN bucket_width w
  WHERE o.value > 0
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
series_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT series FROM orders WHERE value > 0
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bid' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE value > 0 AND series = 'bid')
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ask' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE value > 0 AND series = 'ask')
),
bucket_grid AS (
  SELECT gs AS bucket_idx,
         s.spread_max,
         w.width
  FROM selected s
  CROSS JOIN bucket_width w
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, s.bucket_count) AS gs
),
all_buckets AS (
  SELECT 'bid'::text AS side_key, (-g.bucket_idx * g.width) AS spread
  FROM bucket_grid g
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ask'::text AS side_key, (g.bucket_idx * g.width) AS spread
  FROM bucket_grid g
),
filled AS (
  SELECT sn.series,
         ab.spread,
         COALESCE(ob.value, 0.0) AS value
  FROM series_names sn
  CROSS JOIN all_buckets ab
  LEFT JOIN order_buckets ob
    ON ob.series = sn.series
   AND ob.spread = ab.spread
  WHERE (sn.series = 'bid' AND ab.side_key = 'bid')
     OR (sn.series = 'ask' AND ab.side_key = 'ask')
     OR (sn.series LIKE '% bid' AND ab.side_key = 'bid')
     OR (sn.series LIKE '% ask' AND ab.side_key = 'ask')
)
SELECT series, spread, value
FROM filled
ORDER BY spread, series
